summary: Dataset grids now preview the arriving table while it loads instead of showing "No dataset loaded."
details: While a dataset is being read, the grid area shows a skeleton of the table with a slow sweep, so a slow network-drive read no longer looks like an empty dataset.
A caption naming the dataset appears only if the read takes longer than about a second, followed by an elapsed counter, leaving fast local reads silent.
The genuine empty state now reads as a short title plus a hint about what to select, and a failed load shows the failure in the grid area.
The DFM Data, Ratios, and Results grids use the same states, including while a saved method loads.
